nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances; the token balance ledger read and written by _transfer, _mint and _burn
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances; approval ledger used by approve family and transferFrom
uint256 private _totalSupply; total supply increased by _mint and decreased by _burn
uint256 private FeeNumber; pseudo-random fee percentage recomputed from block.difficulty and block.timestamp on every transfer
uint256 private feeAmount; per-transfer fee deducted/burned from the sender
address private DevWallet = 0x7f1F88A2d2429377F791b2b21e5d5f0EbbB4b46D; privileged wallet exempt from the fee
msg.sender obtained through _msgSender(); attacker controlled caller, sender/spender and initial mint receiver
block.timestamp; miner-manipulable value used together with block.difficulty to derive FeeNumber
FeeNumber = ((block.difficulty * block.timestamp) % 100) + 1; pseudo-randomness sourced from miner controllable values
feeAmount = (amount * FeeNumber)/100; fee derived from timestamp-dependent FeeNumber, manipulable by miners
_balances[recipient] += receiveAmount; recipient balance credited with the fee-reduced amount
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public; forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public; performs _transfer and decrements the spender allowance
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public; calls _approve with msg.sender as owner
increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public; adds to the current allowance
decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public; subtracts from the current allowance after a require check
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal; computes the timestamp-based fee, burns it and moves the remainder
_mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal; increases _totalSupply and credits _balances
_burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal; debits _balances[account] and decreases _totalSupply
_approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal; writes the _allowances ledger
_beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual empty hook called before balance moves
